smoke_puff.use: one puff growing and thinning; particle base for plumes, muzzle smoke, steam (tint)

impact_dust.use: short dust/paint puff at a bullet hit on clinical panels (tint by surface)

fire_loop.use: looping flame for burning consoles, fuel fires (scale and layer 2-3)

explosion.use: fireball cooling to smoke; unshaded (fire is bright in RGB); pair with a light flash

acid_bubble.use: one bubble rising, swelling and popping on an acid/slime pool (tint)

muzzle_flash.use: frames 0-3 front-on star, 4-7 side cone (muzzle on the left); one random frame per shot, 1-2 frames on screen, random roll

electric_arc.use: 4 arcs, one per 64-px row; swap rows every 2-3 frames; shorting panels, cutter, damaged reactor

spark_streak.use: velocity-aligned spark (head on the right); bursts of 8-20 for metal hits and shorting consoles

glow_dot.use: soft glow for embers, spark heads, dust motes in a torch beam, warning-lamp halos (tint)

decal_bullet_holes.use: row 0: holes in bare metal (scuffed ring, soot); row 1: holes in clinical panels (chipped paint, cracks)

decal_splats.use: 0-3 stalker ichor splats (sickly yellow-green; re-tint if the stalker's blood changes); 4-5 scorch marks (explosions, cutter burns); 6-7 puddle shapes for acid/slime pools (white, tint; pair with liquid_noise)

liquid_noise.use: seamless; R/G noise at two scales to scroll against each other for the pool surface (emission + slow distortion), B for bubble spots
